description: This file contains the implementation of a generic Writer class for serializing data into various buffer types, including methods for creating writer instances, writing primitive types, variable-length integers, and managing buffer spans within the Orleans.Serialization framework.

classes.name: Writer
classes.description: A static helper class for creating instances of the generic Writer struct tailored to different buffer types.

classes.name: Writer<TBufferWriter>
classes.description: A ref struct providing methods for writing data to various buffer types within the Orleans.Serialization framework, including span management and variable-length encoding.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory methods for creating Writer instances for different buffer types and streams.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Disposes the underlying buffer writer if it implements IDisposable.

methods.name: Position
methods.description: Returns the current position in the buffer, accounting for previous buffers.

methods.name: WritableSpan
methods.description: Provides access to the current writable span of bytes.

methods.name: AdvanceSpan
methods.description: Advances the current buffer position by a specified number of bytes.

methods.name: Commit
methods.description: Commits the current buffer segment, updating internal state.

methods.name: EnsureContiguous
methods.description: Ensures that there are enough contiguous bytes available for writing.

methods.name: Allocate
methods.description: Allocates a new buffer segment with at least the specified size.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes a span of bytes into the buffer, handling multi-segment writes if necessary.

methods.name: WriteByte
methods.description: Writes a single byte into the buffer.

methods.name: WriteInt32
methods.description: Writes a 32-bit integer into the buffer.

methods.name: WriteInt64
methods.description: Writes a 64-bit integer into the buffer.

methods.name: WriteUInt32
methods.description: Writes an unsigned 32-bit integer into the buffer.

methods.name: WriteUInt64
methods.description: Writes an unsigned 64-bit integer into the buffer.

methods.name: WriteVarUInt7
methods.description: Writes a 7-bit unsigned integer as a variable-length encoded value.

methods.name: WriteVarUInt28
methods.description: Writes a 28-bit unsigned integer as a variable-length encoded value.

methods.name: WriteVarUInt32
methods.description: Writes a 32-bit unsigned integer as a variable-length encoded value.

methods.name: WriteVarUInt56
methods.description: Writes a 56-bit unsigned integer as a variable-length encoded value.

methods.name: WriteVarUInt64
methods.description: Writes a 64-bit unsigned integer as a variable-length encoded value.
